name: ae-kit
description: Agentic Engineering kit: multi-source intake (customer transcripts | customer documents: SRS/BRD/notes | brownfield codebase) with a source manifest → cross-source reconcile (claims: corroborated/single/conflict, human-resolved) → requirements (EARS, multi-source traceable) → design → tasks → sprint contract → one-task loop → independent evaluator → ratchet / replan. Customer-approved UI prototype gate (GP, drift-guarded), three-layer constitution (rules vs product context vs situational principles), 5 quality gates tracked in spec/gates.yaml by a deterministic script, multi-model evaluator panel aggregated by machine, frontier-based question rounds, feature/bugfix/refactor playbooks with pre-agreed test seams, and optional GitHub Issues projection of tasks.
